data.title: 白金 · 珊瑚海岸的夏日私暇
data.description: 【珊瑚海岸度假海滩·午间】热带棕榈树与条纹遮阳伞投下清凉阴凉，白金斜倚在木质沙滩躺椅上，修长指尖托着冰镇海盐柠檬水，微眯着清澈眼眸吹着海风：“呼……这才是生活啊，在罗德岛加班什么的就先忘掉吧。”
data.location: 珊瑚海岸沙滩木质栈桥
data.action: 斜倚躺椅手持冷饮微眯双眸
data.lighting: 碧海蓝天与遮阳伞下的清爽漫射阴影
data.camera: 侧向全身镜头，远景海浪与近景躺椅
data.promptProse: Lounging comfortably under a striped beach parasol on a tropical wooden boardwalk, Platinum rests on a sunbed with glistening turquoise ocean waves in the distance. Her semi-sheer chiffon cover-up flutters gently in the salty ocean breeze as she sips iced lemonade, looking towards the viewer with half-lidded relaxed eyes.
